Send it. It's a logistics text, not a 3 a.m. confession — "what time do you want me there" doesn't read as spiraling, it reads as someone with a pot of beans and a plan.

Only caveat: it's still 3 a.m., so if you'd rather it not land while Beto's asleep, schedule it for 8 and go to bed. Either way, you've already done the hard part — you know what you're bringing and why. The text is just the receipt.
